hero.title: Your finances under control
hero.description: Argentum is a personal financial assistant: accounts, transactions, budgets, goals, and analytics in one app. Plan, track, and achieve your financial goals.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Manage all your accounts in one place — from cash to credit cards.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: Record income and expenses with filters, sorting, and categories.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Flexible categories with icons to see where your money actually goes.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.description: Set category limits and control your spending throughout the month.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: Save up for dreams and track progress toward every financial goal.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Visual charts for income, expenses, and monthly dynamics by category.

notice.title: Registration Required
notice.description: Viewing the dashboard, accounts, transactions, budgets, goals, and analytics is available to registered users only. Create a free account to start managing your finances.
